name: 01013 · Chicopee, MA
findings: ZIP 01013 (Chicopee) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01013 (Chicopee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01013 (Chicopee) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).
